No need to unstack and unseal multiple containers to find a specific dish; their crystal clear Tritan construction lets you see what you've stored at a glance. This material also provides stain and odor resistance to keep the container spotless and fresh after every use. Want an easier way to re heat leftovers? Built in vents allow steam to escape so you can microwave food without removing the lid.
